item.title: Mindset The Key For Ireland V France
item.description: Ireland captain Caelan Doris says the squad are ready to "embrace" the hostile atmosphere awaiting them at the Stade de France tonight. They kick off their Six Nations campaign against defending champions France. The visitors haven't won in Paris since Johnny Sexton’s last second drop goal in 2018. Advertisement It's Ireland's first return to the French capital since their agonising World Cup quarter?final defeat to New Zealand in 2023. Doris knows that mindset will play a big part…

item.title: Almost 7% of the housing stock in Kerry is vacant
item.description: Almost 7% of the housing stock in Kerry is vacant. That’s according to figures in the GeoDirectory Residential Buildings Report for the fourth quarter of 2025. The data, prepared by EY, also shows that the residential vacancy rate in Kerry is above the national average. item.title: 31 patients waiting on trolleys in University Hospital Kerry
item.description: There are 31 patients waiting on trolleys in University Hospital Kerry today. That’s according to figures from the Irish Nurses’ and Midwives’ Organisation. They show there are 17 patients waiting on a trolley in UHK’s emergency department, while a further 14 people are waiting on trolleys in wards within the hospital. item.description: A major Hollywood star is set to visit Kerry in the coming months. Brad Pitt will head to Cahersiveen to shoot his latest movie. item.title: Sigerson Semi Final Delayed
item.description: Tonight's Sigerson Cup semi-final between UL and Queen's has been postponed. That last-four clash had been slated for DCU St Clare's, but is off due to the orange weather warning for Dublin. As it stands, UCC's game against University of Galway is still going ahead at the Mardyke, with throw-in at 8. Advertisement UL will be looking to emulate their hurlers who advanced to the Fitzgibbon Cup final last night to set up a meeting with Limerick rivals Mary I.

item.title: Around 140 jobs to go at KOSTAL, Abbeyfeale
item.description: SIPTU has confirmed that around 140 staff at KOSTAL, Abbeyfeale are to lose their jobs after the company told workers that it's to move a production line to China. The news is not unexpected. There has been speculation since at least last March that the German-owned company intended to shift some of its production abroad.
